source.owner_goal: 建立三間汽車保養維修廠營運 ChatGPT App：先診斷等待過久的根因，再管理預約、接車、工單、技師技能、工位、零件等待、報價核准、進度通知與完工交車。不得在未驗證根因前只做排班系統。需要前後端網站、管理後台、工具、技能、測試與 ZIP。

owner_must_do: 登入 Google Cloud 或 provider
設定 OAuth consent screen、應用程式名稱、授權網域、隱私權政策與支援信箱
建立 Web OAuth client 並加入目前專案實際需要的 authorized JavaScript origins
agent_can_do: 從實際 runtime 判斷 website login 是 ID-token POST 或 authorization-code callback
產生實際需要的 origin、redirect URI 與 env manifest
產生 Google 官方設定逐欄引導
產生 ChatGPT 送審 OAuth 一致性檢查表
引導 owner 提供遮罩後的官方完成狀態，不要求任何 secret 值
agent_must_not_do: 要求使用者把密碼或 OTP 貼進聊天
把 client secret 寫入 repo
重用參考案例的 client id、client secret、redirect uri 或品牌資料

frontend_contract: login page must preserve safe next=/oauth-continue?...
cross-origin auth fetch must include credentials when cookie sessions are used
account switching must be available for cross-account testing
backend_contract: Google ID token audience, issuer and signature are verified server-side before creating a local session
session cookie is httpOnly and secure in production
protected APIs authorize by local account and role, not by raw Google token in the browser

stage2_domain_handoff.rule: Stage 3 may consume a custom domain only after Stage 2 records READY with verified HTTPS.

owner_login_redirect_contract.credential_delivery: Google POST form with double-submit g_csrf_token validation

member_login_redirect_contract.credential_delivery: Google POST form with double-submit g_csrf_token validation
member_login_redirect_contract.safe_return: short-lived SameSite=None HTTPS cookie containing only a normalized local path

branding.logo_policy: use only a project-owned verified logo; otherwise leave unset

audience_and_publication.test_user_source: owner Google account selected in the authorized browser; never store its password or OTP
audience_and_publication.production_publish_requires: owner confirmation plus branding, domain, policy, scope, and live-login evidence

runtime_dependencies.reason: google.auth.transport.requests requires both google-auth and the requests transport package in a clean deployment

production_persistence.session_secret: APPFACTORY_SESSION_SECRET must be stable across restarts and deployments
production_persistence.durability_declaration: APPFACTORY_AUTH_STORAGE_DURABLE=true only after the persistent path is mounted and verified
production_persistence.completion_gate: A successful live login on ephemeral storage is test evidence, not production-ready membership evidence

render_default.architecture: paid Render web service plus minimum persistent disk plus SQLite
render_default.why: Reuse the proven simple single-instance pattern before introducing managed PostgreSQL complexity.
render_default.scale_up_rule: Monitor capacity and increase disk only when evidence requires it; Render disks cannot be reduced afterward.

pre_purchase_automatic_work: generate the disk mount and SQLite path contract
prepare APPFACTORY_SESSION_SECRET, APPFACTORY_ADMIN_EMAILS, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and APPFACTORY_AUTH_DB_PATH variable names
prepare a safe SQLite copy and integrity-check plan
production_persistence.single_paid_owner_action: confirm the Render paid service and persistent-disk purchase in the provider checkout
post_purchase_automatic_work: set APPFACTORY_AUTH_STORAGE_DURABLE=true only after the mount is verified
migrate existing SQLite membership data without overwriting a newer durable database
deploy, log in, deploy again, and verify the same user_id and owner_admin membership remain
production_persistence.postgresql_policy: PostgreSQL is optional for multi-instance concurrency or operational scale; it is not required for the initial Stage 3 Google login launch.

automatic_on: stage_3_google_membership starts for the current customer project
a customer-owned custom domain is added or removed
provider authorization is revoked, expired, or fails live verification
trigger_policy.not_triggered_by: An ordinary website login alone does not mutate Google Cloud; starting the disclosed Stage 3 setup records one authorization for the covered setup actions.
trigger_policy.resume_behavior: After the owner starts the disclosed Stage 3 setup in an authenticated browser, continue through every covered non-secret provider action without repeated confirmations or repeated project data.

owner_account_selection.source_of_truth: the current customer project's registered owner_admin Google email; never infer ownership from account order or another project's session
agent_behavior: when an account chooser is visible, select only the exact registered owner_admin email
if the exact account is already active, continue without asking the owner to choose again
if the exact account is absent, use Add another account or Switch account and pause only for password, OTP, or CAPTCHA
after provider authentication, verify the returned email and Google sub resolve to this project's owner_admin before any admin action
never: select the first or default account without an exact match
assume a Codex, ChatGPT, Google Cloud, or Render session belongs to the same person without project ownership evidence
apply the owner account hint to ordinary public member login
owner_account_selection.public_member_login: Every member chooses and verifies their own Google account; owner auto-selection is restricted to the project-owner setup and verification flow.

first_consent_handoff.trigger: Stage 3 purchase or owner-authorized Stage 3 start reaches the first live Google login verification
first_consent_handoff.user_message: 若 Google 顯示選擇帳戶，請點選購買第三階段時登記的管理者 Google 帳號；完成後系統會自動繼續，不需要重新下指令。
first_consent_handoff.maximum_owner_actions: one account click, plus only provider-required password, OTP, or CAPTCHA
must_not: pause for another confirmation between non-secret setup steps
send the owner back to repeat project information
wait silently after opening the provider account chooser
first_consent_handoff.public_member_separation: This owner setup message appears only on flow=owner_setup; ordinary member login keeps the normal member-facing copy.

owner_login_transport.reason: Keep first owner consent on a controllable full-page route and prevent a detached popup from losing the continuation signal.
owner_login_transport.csrf_guard: Require Google's g_csrf_token form value to exactly match its cookie before verifying the credential.
owner_login_transport.ordinary_member_login: same-page redirect uses /api/auth/google/member-callback and never grants owner_admin without server-side membership verification

sequence: record the initiating login page before clicking the Google button
wait for either a controllable popup/page or a provider-native account chooser
reacquire the popup/page immediately when the automation surface exposes it
run exact owner_admin account matching before clicking any account
wait for the popup to close or the initiating page to receive the Google credential
verify /api/me and same-project owner_admin before declaring success
success_gate: Google credential accepted by the deployed backend
owner-only page is accessible and logout clears the session
must_not_mark_complete_on: an account row clicked without backend identity proof
provider_popup_takeover.native_surface_fallback: If the provider intentionally exposes a non-controllable native identity surface, show the exact matched owner account and one-action handoff immediately; never wait silently. Resume automatically after that single owner click.
provider_popup_takeover.timeout_behavior: Return a structured provider_popup_not_controllable or owner_account_not_present result promptly; never remain waiting without a visible next action.

google_button_configuration.expected_effect: Use a full-page Google redirect so embedded and in-app browsers do not silently stall on FedCM or detached popup handling.
google_button_configuration.fedcm_retry_policy: Do not rely on FedCM or a detached popup for ordinary login; use the fixed server callback and never leave a clickable button with no visible result.
google_button_configuration.identity_guard: The backend still verifies the ID token audience and maps Google sub plus verified email to this project's membership before granting owner_admin.

one_time_authorization.scope: the exact customer project, existing OAuth client, and manifest URL additions disclosed for this Stage 3 run
covers: application name and same-account support/contact email
external testing audience and owner test user
customer-project domains, JavaScript origins, and discovered redirect URIs
Google OAuth web client creation or minimal update
Google API User Data Policy checkbox when it is explicitly included in the Stage 3 start disclosure
one_time_authorization.save_behavior: Codex clicks Google Cloud Save automatically after the scoped authorization; the owner is not asked to click the routine Save button.

provider_mutation_state_machine.authorization_gate: Require one action-time confirmation naming the exact customer project, existing OAuth client, and sanitized URL additions before the first persistent provider mutation.
automatic_after_gate: read the current sanitized origins and redirect URIs
compute an add-only exact-value diff against the generated manifest
add only missing values and deduplicate exact normalized entries
click the Google Cloud Save button automatically
wait for an explicit provider save-success message and for pending progress to finish
reload the existing OAuth client and read back the sanitized origins and redirect URIs
compare the read-back state and fingerprint with the manifest
wait for provider propagation, then run deployed login, callback, session, and logout verification
success_evidence: all required origins and redirect URIs read back exactly
provider_mutation_state_machine.failure_behavior: Fail closed with the exact safe error code; do not create another OAuth client, delete old URLs, or rotate a secret to bypass a save/read-back failure.
provider_mutation_state_machine.truth_boundary: A provider save and read-back prove configuration persistence only; LIVE_LOGIN_VERIFIED still requires the deployed Google callback, /api/me, session, protected route, and logout checks.

agent_steps: select or create the Google Cloud project that belongs to this customer project
match the visible Google account exactly to this customer project's registered owner_admin before changing provider configuration
open Google Auth Platform Branding and fill the project application name
fill only existing project homepage, privacy, terms, support, and verified logo fields
keep a public project in external testing mode and add the owner as a test user
open Clients, choose Web application, and fill the project name
add the manifest JavaScript origins and only the redirect URIs required by a discovered runtime callback
request only openid, email, and profile for basic sign-in
after the scoped owner authorization, click Save automatically, wait for provider success, reopen the client, and verify the sanitized provider configuration against this manifest
owner_only_steps: enter Google password, OTP, or solve CAPTCHA
complete domain ownership or Google verification submission not included in the recorded Stage 3 authorization

otp.plain_language_message: 請開啟當初綁定目前服務帳號的驗證器 App，輸入該服務顯示的 6 位數動態碼；若無法使用驗證器，請改用服務提供的備用碼或帳號復原。請勿把驗證碼貼到聊天。
otp.agent_behavior: Keep the authorized browser on the exact OTP page, identify the provider by name, and resume automatically after the owner submits the code without requiring another command.

password.plain_language_message: 請直接在目前供應商的登入頁輸入密碼，不要貼到聊天；登入完成後 Codex 會從原步驟自動續接。

captcha.plain_language_message: 請在目前頁面完成人機驗證；完成後 Codex 會從原步驟自動續接。

browser_runbook.credential_preservation: Never delete the OAuth client to repair a secret-handling issue. Preserve the client ID, origins, and login service; rotate only the affected secret when the runtime uses one.
browser_runbook.url_update_guard: URL-only maintenance is add-only by default: never delete an existing valid URI, recreate the OAuth client, or create/rotate a client secret merely to apply or repair origins and redirect URIs.

maintenance.repair_policy: Compute a minimal add-only diff, preserve valid existing entries and the OAuth client ID, use the scoped Stage 3 action-time authorization for covered mutations, let Codex save and read back automatically, rotate only an affected secret when separately required, then rerun live login and the discovered runtime flow verification.

execution_sequence: inspect project and preserve existing authentication
implement or confirm the login button, verified identity route, session, logout, and protected-route checks; require callback only when the runtime uses one
apply the provider manifest in an owner-authorized browser
store credentials only through the deployment secret manager owner surface
deploy and verify health separately from Google login
run the discovered login flow, identity, session, logout, authorization, mobile, and regression checks
record safe evidence and leave any unobserved layer incomplete

lifecycle_policy.authorization_expired_or_revoked: start a fresh owner-visible authorization; never extend or forge a token expiry
lifecycle_policy.credential_rotation_due: create a replacement only with owner confirmation, deploy it through secret storage, verify login, then retire the old credential
lifecycle_policy.verification_due: surface the official due date and owner action; never claim or fabricate an extension
lifecycle_policy.url_changed: run the sync diff, merge new origins and redirect URIs, deploy, then verify before considering removal of old valid URLs

google_provider_automation.truth_boundary: This manifest and runbook make provider setup repeatable, but do not prove that Google Cloud was changed. Live completion requires owner-authorized browser/provider evidence and deployed login verification.

must_align: protected resource metadata when MCP is used
refresh token lifecycle when long-lived connector sessions are required
reviewer test path with seeded non-sensitive data
must_not: make reviewer use the owner's Google account
require real payment to test basic protected flow
use JavaScript-only approval buttons for external OAuth clients
change scopes or redirect URIs between website login and ChatGPT submission without a new review

reference_incident_lessons: OAuth resume loss after Google login breaks external connector authorization even when login itself succeeds.
Missing credentials include on cross-origin login can prevent the backend session cookie from landing.
Settings showing a connector is connected is not proof that the current chat loaded tools.
Authorization approval should have a plain link-navigation route as the stable path for external clients.
Unauthorized MCP or protected API probes should return an auth challenge, not data or a generic backend failure.
Live proof must separate local plan, provider console setup, deployed callback, native ChatGPT or connector transcript, and review approval.

identity_rbac_abuse_contract.stage_3: bind verified OAuth/session identity to project membership and enforce RBAC
identity_rbac_abuse_contract.stage_6: operate retention, per-subject limits, restrictions, alerts and owner audit
identity_rbac_abuse_contract.persistence_requirement: APPFACTORY_SECURITY_DB_PATH must point to durable storage before deployed monitoring can be marked PASS

session_policy.cookie: httpOnly, secure in production, sameSite appropriate for ChatGPT/OAuth flow
session_policy.token_storage: server-side or signed session only; never expose OAuth refresh token to frontend
session_policy.logout: clear session and revoke project-local session; provider revocation optional by provider capability

unified_member_identity_chain.external_identity_key: Google verified sub; email is profile/contact data and must not be the permanent identity key
unified_member_identity_chain.rule: Every consumer resolves the same server-side user_id from a verified session. Website, MCP, quota, payment, entitlement, notification, and ops must not create separate member identities.
unified_member_identity_chain.api_token_boundary: Project API tokens, when needed, are server-issued credentials bound to user_id, tenant_id, project_id, scopes, expiry, revocation and audit; never treat a Google ID token as the application's long-lived API token.

project_owner_binding.source_of_truth: the Google account registered for the current customer project purchase or owner-authorized Stage 3 start
project_owner_binding.binding_key: verified Google sub plus current project_id; email is used only for initial exact-account matching and contact
project_owner_binding.role: owner_admin for this customer project only
project_owner_binding.subscription_independence: owner_admin maintenance, testing, export and rollback access cannot be removed by subscription expiry, quota exhaustion or a later stage purchase
project_owner_binding.stage_entitlement_boundary: purchased stages unlock customer-facing build capabilities; they never grant mother-system admin, other-project access or provider approval
project_owner_binding.codex_rule: Before project mutation, Codex must resolve the active verified Google identity to the same project_id owner_admin and reject any mother-system, reference-product or other-customer context.

reviewer_path.purpose: OpenAI/ChatGPT review must be able to test without being blocked by unclear login or paid-only access.
options: seeded test data with no real customer data
must_not: 給 reviewer 真實付費者資料
讓 reviewer 需要真刷卡才可測基本功能

capabilities: verified Google identity to project-local user/session
project-local SQLite identity and membership persistence
not_copied_from_mother: full internal capability catalog or routing recipes
generated_runtime.adapter_boundary: The selected backend adapter must wire this compact project runtime to its own routes. Reviewer login, external MCP OAuth authorization-code issuance, provider credentials and live deployment require separate project-scoped adapters and evidence.

validation_gates: login page renders
Google OAuth console settings are owner-confirmed without exposing secrets
generated Google OAuth manifest is derived from this project rather than a reference project
OAuth configuration sync is idempotent and reports only missing or stale values
provider-managed preview domains are not claimed as owner-authorized production domains
admin OAuth status is owner_admin-only and never returns secrets or tokens
safe next=/oauth-continue is preserved after login/register
cross-origin login uses credentials include when cookie sessions are used
callback route exists
state and redirect_uri are preserved through authorization
PKCE challenge and verifier path is tested for external OAuth clients
session persists across protected API call
logout clears session
different Google accounts resolve to different local user identities
/api/auth/google, /api/me, MCP, quota, plans, payments, entitlements, notifications and ops resolve the same server-side user_id
user-supplied owner/admin claims never elevate privileges
tenant and project membership are checked before owner/admin access
security event persistence stores hashes and classifications but no raw prompt or secret
mobile login and callback complete without blank page or hidden overflow blocking action buttons
reviewer path can access test-only data
owner_admin remains authorized when plan, subscription or quota state changes
a customer project's owner_admin never becomes mother-system admin or another project's admin
MCP unauthorized returns proper auth challenge when needed
ChatGPT OAuth metadata endpoints are reachable after deployment
ChatGPT native or review test transcript shows the external client completed OAuth and called the protected tool

next_stage_recommendation.plain_next_prompt: 幫我把登入、OAuth、角色權限接到後端 API 和 MCP 權限檢查。

reference_case_policy: Use completed reference cases only for reusable auth/OAuth/reviewer gates; do not copy accounts, secrets, tokens, brand, or production paths.
truth_boundary: Auth/OAuth login planning proof only. It creates login, session, role, OAuth metadata, reviewer path, owner-action, and validation plans. It is not Google Cloud OAuth configuration proof, real credential proof, live login proof, deployed callback proof, ChatGPT OAuth proof, or approval proof.
